about_the_game:
This free demo contains some introductory content from the full version of Retro Rewind - Video Store Simulator.

Run Your Video Store

Relive the golden ages of video rentals by opening your very own video store. Rent, sell, organize and build your business from the ground up and revisit those beloved childhood memories!

Serve Your Customers

Operate the cash register, give movie recommendations or make your clients their favorite snacks. There are many things to do in a day's work when managing your store!  

Customize Your Store

Modify the walls and floors, decorate with posters and memorabilia and expand the layout of your shop to create the ultimate rental destination.

Collect Movies & New Releases

Fill your shelves with thousands of unique VHS tapes, each with their own title, genre, cover art and rental statistics! Each week's new releases are inspired by real movies, iconic cult classics of the 80s.  

Order Movies, Furniture & More

Browse the local furniture catalogue for different shelves, signs or the coolest gumball machine. Order movies on your old PC or buy exclusive bootleg films from a shady Tape Dealer. There are many ways to grow your inventory!


Additional Game Features:

  • Manage Your Returns:  Add returned movies in the system, rewind tapes and set aside reserved movies for your customers.

  • Build Your Dream Team: Hire staff to give you a hand on daily tasks to run your store.

  • Evolving Customer Interactions: Seasons, weather and holidays will affect gameplay and what your customers rent! Be ready, rainy Friday nights are crazy busy in the store!

  • Seasons & Festivals: Play through all four seasons as the environment transforms around you. Each season features special holidays and festivals, all brought to life with unique artwork!

  • Share Movies With Your Friends: Every movie can be ordered on your PC with a unique code that you can share with your friends!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3570K
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce 560 GTX
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: While we use Unreal Engine, we do not utilize heavy graphics features such as Nanite, Lumen, Deferred Rendering, or TSR. The game includes extensive customizable graphics options.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i7-4770
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce 970 GTX
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
